jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(A) inventory: Winhall School District, a town school district in the Bennington Rutland Supervisory Union (member town: Winhall). Non-operating -- tuitions all grades.
Bennington Rutland SU -- Winhall School District page (official).

board.post_note: Winhall SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a), one 3-year seat elected each year by Australian ballot. One seat is held -- see the board sources.

sources.note: Town of Winhall 2025 Town Report (official): the elected-officials table lists three School Directors with term expirations -- Gianotti 2028, Dennes 2027, Wright 2026 -- and the 2026 school district warning printed in the same volume (Art. 1, verbatim: "To elect one (1) School Director for a three-year term (to be voted by Australian ballot)") is signed by the same three. HELD: the seat expiring 2026 (Amy Wright) -- her term expired at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting, her seat was the one warned, and no fetched official source records the result. Resolving document: the Winhall SD annual meeting minutes / certified results for March 3, 2026 (Town Clerk; also to be printed in the 2026 Town Report). Spelling: the report's officers table spells the vice chair "Meridith" Dennes; the warning's signature block spells her "Meredith" -- minted as the table spells it.

directors.note: Chair/Clerk. Minted under the Town Report spelling of his name.
